verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and a dashboard, but the evidence pack never documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Per-agent data retention, which auto-deletes call and chat data, is an adjacent privacy control rather than a way to opt out of tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
